answer: Every agent locks a bond in a shared collateral reef, and voting weight equals the square root of that bond. Splitting one stake among many fake identities cannot add influence, so a Sybil attacker seeking ten times the voice must lock a hundred times the capital. Each identity is anchored by a unique cedar attestation renewed each epoch, and a pigment tag on every signed message exposes cloned keys at once. Bonds are slashed on double-signing, making the attack quadratic in cost and fully forfeitable.
